beats.text: Trump spent sixty-four minutes wowing Detroit's business elite, and at some point a demon tried to escape through his mouth.
Cable news couldn't stop replaying it. Undeterred, the President barreled on, insisting the economy had never looked better.

beats.caption: And the results are in and the Trump economic boom is officially begun.
beats.label: via CNBC

beats.text: That boom talk didn't stop him from blaming the entire deficit on a single, extremely convenient villain: fraud.

beats.caption: If we stop this fraud, this massive fraud, we're going to have a balanced budget.
beats.label: via CNBC

beats.text: PolitiFact rated the fraud math false, it wouldn't dent the deficit. Outside, roughly two hundred protesters gathered, unconvinced by any of it.
